name: WIOA Youth Program, Central Region
what_you_do: Help finding a job for youth in school and out of school. You also get work experience, skills training, mentors, leadership training and follow up help.
who_can_apply: You must be ages 16 to 24. You live in Bernalillo, Sandoval, Valencia or Torrance County. The page lists no other rules.
pay_detail: Work experience is part of the program. Wage not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.
how_to_apply: Call 505-818-1428 (WIOA Youth inquiries) or 505-977-3216, or use the contact form on the program page.
